content.query:
----1
SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, COUNT(1)
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountPayroll WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId
HAVING COUNT(1)> 1

----2
SELECT
CustomerAccountId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,Timestamp
,EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator
,EmployerPayrollAccountIndicator
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
INTO BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_REMDUP
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountPayroll
GROUP BY 
CustomerAccountId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,Timestamp
,EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator
,EmployerPayrollAccountIndicator
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId

----3
SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, COUNT(1)
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_REMDUP WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId
HAVING COUNT(1)> 1

----4
RENAME OBJECT BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountPayroll TO CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_BU_20230627

----5
RENAME OBJECT BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_REMDUP TO CoreCustomerAccountPayroll

----6
SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, COUNT(1)
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountPayroll WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId
HAVING COUNT(1)> 1
